title: Control and Decay

scene.description: A sterile white room features a towering Director gesturing to scientific equipment, while Linda lies motionless on a hospital bed. A pug-faced twin is suspended in an incubator, and medical monitors track vital signs. Cold blue light highlights the oppressive atmosphere of genetic control.
scene.action: Director demonstrates reproductive technology while Linda dies in her final moments

characters.name: Director
characters.pose: Standing at a podium with arms spread wide

environment.lighting: Cold, harsh overhead lights with frozen blue shadows
environment.architecture: Glass and nickel equipment with sterile white walls

composition.focalPoint: Director's outstretched arms and Linda's hospital bed

prompt: Photorealistic sci-fi scene of the Central London Hatchery's Conditioning Centre: Director stands at a podium with arms spread wide, gesturing to test-tubes and incubators while Linda lies motionless on a hospital bed with labored breathing, surrounded by medical monitors and a pug-faced twin in an incubator. Cold blue light casts harsh shadows across sterile white walls etched with the World State motto. Symmetrical composition emphasizes the oppressive atmosphere of genetic control and human decay.
assumptions: Director's hair is thin and silver, matching World State's emphasis on youth
Linda's hospital pajamas are plain white with frayed edges
Head Nurse wears a grey-and-white striped uniform with a name tag
Pug-faced twin has a flattened muzzle and wide-set eyes
Director's gloves are pale rubber with cracked seams
Hospital bed has a metal frame and thin, white linens
World State motto is etched in faded gold on the building
